## State Variables
### deployedAt
Timestamp when the contract was deployed

Used for tracking contract age and potential migrations


```solidity
uint256 public deployedAt
```


### rewardsToken
Token being distributed as rewards

Set at deployment and cannot be changed


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable rewardsToken
```


### roots
Mapping of distribution indices to their Merkle roots

Each distribution has a unique index and corresponding root hash


```solidity
mapping(uint256 index => bytes32 rootHash) public roots
```


### claimedRoots
Tracks which distributions have been claimed by each user

Uses bitmap for gas-efficient storage


```solidity
mapping(address user => BitMaps.BitMap claimedRoots) private claimedRoots
```

INTERNALS

### _verifyClaim

Verifies that a claim is valid and has not already been made

Reverts if the proof is invalid or if the user already claimed


```solidity
function _verifyClaim(address user, uint256 index, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory proof) internal view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The address of the user attempting to claim|
|`index`|`uint256`|The distribution index|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The reward amount to claim|
|`proof`|`bytes32[]`|The Merkle proof verifying inclusion|


### _processClaim

Processes a single claim by verifying it, marking it as claimed in the bitmap, and emitting an event


```solidity
function _processClaim(
    address user,
    uint256 index,
    uint256 amount,
    bytes32[] calldata proof,
    BitMaps.BitMap storage userClaimedRoots
)
    internal;
```
**Parameters**

|----|----|-----------|

|`amount`|`uint256`|The reward amount|
|`proof`|`bytes32[]`|The Merkle proof verifying inclusion|
|`userClaimedRoots`|`BitMaps.BitMap`|The bitmap tracking claimed roots for the user|
